summary: Enhance your skills with our Geospatial Data Management Training Course. Learn to effectively manage and analyze geospatial data for impactful decision-making.
lede: Geospatial data management covers how geographic information is organized, maintained and shared across systems. It is for GIS managers, spatial data architects and other professionals responsible for spatial data, with practical guidance on designing spatial databases, building data-integration workflows, and managing metadata and quality checks to support data discovery and distribution.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who have moved beyond basic GIS operations and are now responsible for the integrity, architecture, and distribution of spatial assets at scale.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of GIS software (such as QGIS or ArcGIS Pro®) and a basic understanding of relational databases. Familiarity with SQL is recommended but not required, as core concepts will be reviewed. No prior programming experience is necessary, though exposure to Python is beneficial for the automation modules.
